name: Signal Hill
text: Signal Hill is a city 2.2 mi2 (5.7 km2) in area in Los Angeles County, California, United States. Partially high on an eponymous hill, the city is an enclave completely surrounded by the city of Long Beach. Signal Hill was incorporated on April 22, 1924, roughly three years after oil was discovered there.

depictions.name: Signal Hill
depictions.text: Signal Hill is the crime scene of the case The White Shoe Slaying. It is a wooded hill in Westlake near the mountains. It possesses a police call box, used by Cole to call the dry cleaners.
